method: Read the team brief and plan (newsroom.sgit.ai) and sgit.ai/llms.txt for who we are (sgit vaults, RiskMandate Agent Behaviour Policies, SHarness, the newsroom API). Then read the server-rendered HTML of websummit.com (robots.txt allows all but /api/): the 2026 event partners page (first 40 partners embedded in the page), the featured startups page (first 100, alphabetical A to Su, all GROWTH), the speakers and featured attendees pages (first 20 each), the schedule page (first sessions), and the track pages. Each entry carries conferenceSlug "lis26", which is what makes it a 2026 confirmation; each links to a public /appearances/lis26/<id>/<slug> or /attendees/lis26/<id>/<slug> page, from which the company website was read. The rest of each list is loaded client-side from a search service and was NOT read (see notes). Added press (Lusa via AMAN, Fast Company ME, The Portugal Guides, Executive Digest, IBTimes Colombia) and one third-party startup list (Future Feed), used only as "unconfirmed" leads unless the company is also on websummit.com. Filtered for relevance to us: AI-agent security and governance, identity, devtools for agents, GRC, Portugal, and a few investors and policy bodies. Homepage titles/meta descriptions were read for speakers' companies. First pass by the researcher on 1 November 2026: the first page of each official list only (partners, featured startups to 'Su', speakers, featured attendees); the rest of each list is loaded by the browser and was not read. Later wakes extend it.
